title: Example Project
summary: A short, factual description of what the project does and why it matters.
one_liner: One-line outcome with the verified metric.
problem: What breaks in the real world that this project solves. State it plainly.
build: What was built, in concrete terms. Real components only.
flow: optional pipeline like: discover -> qualify -> draft -> approve -> send
proof: Verified test result, e.g. 10/10 acceptance tests passed. Demo uses synthetic data.
private_notes: Anything that must never be published. Builder-only.
